verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs say its agents "implement features" and "write tests" from prompts. They also run and test changes in isolated sandboxes, present a structured implementation plan, and open pull requests, which covers the end-to-end flow. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the test-authoring workflow (frameworks, coverage expectations), and independent or hands-on corroboration that features are delivered end-to-end with tests.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
